topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: V-band is preferred in high-data-rate applications due to its higher bandwidth capacity and reduced interference. Beam divergence and nonlinear effects impact link performance, but adaptive beamforming and modulation techniques mitigate these effects. Doppler shift introduces frequency offsets, yet adaptive modulation ensures link integrity.
reference_context: SatCom systems use various frequency bands, including Ku, Ka, and V-band, for inter-satellite communication, with each band having unique characteristics and applications.
